headline: Nuvama keeps Buy rating on Inventurus Knowledge Solutions
hook: Brokerage maintains bullish stance on Inventurus
summary: Brokerage firm Nuvama has reiterated its 'Buy' rating on Inventurus Knowledge Solutions. The firm has set a price target of Rs 2,200 for the stock. This recommendation reflects the brokerage's continued confidence in the company's growth prospects.
why_it_matters: Brokerage target updates can influence short-term stock price momentum.
